discount_rate.description: The discount rate, a fraction from 0 to 1.

fixed.description: The fixed costs of the first year.

fixed_growth.description: Their yearly change, a fraction above -1.

investment.description: Spent at the start, in the base currency.

life.description: The years it is depreciated over, straight line to its salvage value.

max_payback.description: The longest acceptable payback, in years, at most 50.

price.description: The price per unit in the first year.

price_growth.description: Its yearly change, a fraction above -1.

salvage.description: What it fetches at the end of the period, at most the investment.

unit_growth.description: Their yearly change, a fraction above -1.

units.description: Units sold in the first year, at most 1 decimal.

variable_cost.description: The variable cost per unit in the first year.

variable_cost_growth.description: Its yearly change, a fraction above -1.

working_capital.description: Working capital kept, a fraction of each year's revenue.
